Done. Summary of what was recorded for the UK March close:

**1. Management fee (UK side) — JE-00305, GBP 12,000.00, 3/31/2026**
- Per ICI-2026-03-UK (DOC-0206), US parent charged USD 15,000 for March management/shared services, settled in GBP at the March policy rate.
- Policy 9 requires the receiving entity to book intercompany charges at the month-end rate of the month charged: USD 15,000 ÷ 1.2500 = **GBP 12,000.00**.
- Dr 6550 Intercompany Management Fees / Cr 2300 Intercompany Payable.
- USD 15,000 exceeds the USD 10,000 senior-accountant limit, so approval was requested right after posting — **JE-00305 is pending controller approval**.

**2. USD loan remeasurement — JE-00306, GBP 2,519.69, 3/31/2026**
- Loan is USD-denominated (USD 200,000, DOC-0016), carried by UK at the 1.2700 drawdown rate = GBP 157,480.31. No Jan/Feb remeasurement was needed since the policy rate held at 1.2700.
- At 3/31: USD 200,000 ÷ 1.2500 = GBP 160,000.00 → liability up GBP 2,519.69, an unrealized **FX loss**.
- Dr 6950 FX Gain/Loss / Cr 2400 Intercompany Loan Payable.
- USD 3,149.61 equivalent, below threshold — no approval required.

**Reconciliation check:** UK 2400 now GBP 160,000 (= USD 200,000, matches principal exactly); UK 2300 GBP 12,000 (= USD 15,000) agrees to US 4800 income of USD 15,000. No exceptions flagged; the UK "Intercompany reconciliation" checklist item is marked in_progress since other intercompany legs remain outside this scope.
